extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and their attorneys/agents filing applications with the USPTO (including those using ADS/reference filings and provisional filings)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and procedural requirements for establishing a U.S. patent application filing date and completing/maintaining an application (nonprovisional, provisional, and filing-by-reference), including fees, oaths/declarations, ADS/reference filing, certified copies, and conversion procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing date threshold (35 U.S.C. 111)
rubrics_metrics.description: The filing date of an application shall be the date on which a specification, with or without claims, is received in the United States Patent and Trademark Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 35 U.S.C. 111 and 37 CFR 1.53(b)/(c) govern what papers must be received to accord a filing date; for provisionals, the filing date rules are similarly applied per 37 CFR 1.53(c). If filing date is refused, petition under 37 CFR 1.53(e)(2) with fee (37 CFR 1.17(f)) is required for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required contents of an application (35 U.S.C. 111(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: An application shall include: (A) a specification as prescribed by section 112; (B) a drawing as prescribed by section 113; and (C) an oath or declaration as prescribed by section 115.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fee, oath or declaration, and one or more claims may be submitted after the filing date within such period and conditions (including payment of a surcharge) as prescribed by the Director; failure to submit within the prescribed period results in abandonment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice to file missing parts (37 CFR 1.53(f)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: If the application does not contain the basic filing fee, search fee, examination fee, or if the application under 37 CFR 1.53(b) does not contain the inventor's oath or declaration, the Office provides a notice requiring payment/filing within the time period set in the notice to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicant has provided a correspondence address (37 CFR 1.33(a)), the Office will send the notice and set the time period. Applicant must pay required fees (including surcharge if applicable under 1.16(f)) within the notice period to avoid abandonment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of correspondence address on timing (37 CFR 1.53(f)(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant has not provided a correspondence address and is missing fees or an oath/declaration, the applicant must pay the basic filing fee, search fee, and examination fee and any required surcharge within three months from the filing date to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing a correspondence address allows the Office to notify the applicant and set a reply period; absence of such address invokes the three-month statutory period (not extendable under 37 CFR 1.136 for certain pre-AIA cases as noted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Postponement of inventor's oath or declaration (37 CFR 1.53(f)(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: The inventor's oath or declaration in an application under 37 CFR 1.53(b) must be filed within the period specified in 37 CFR 1.53(f)(1) or (f)(2), except that filing may be postponed until the application is otherwise in condition for allowance under conditions specified in 37 CFR 1.53(f)(3)(i)-(ii).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Postponing the oath/declaration requires payment of the surcharge under 37 CFR 1.16(f) if the oath/declaration is not submitted on filing; the surcharge cannot be postponed until a Notice of Allowance or payment of the issue fee but must be paid in the time period specified in 1.53(f)(1) or (f)(2). If surcharge not paid at filing, the Office will send a Notice to File Missing Parts requiring it.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADS requirements to postpone oath/declaration (37 CFR 1.53(f)(3)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: To postpone filing the oath/declaration, the application must be an original (non-reissue) application that contains an application data sheet (ADS) in accordance with 37 CFR 1.76 identifying each inventor by legal name and a mailing address (and residence if different).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If these ADS requirements are met and applicable fees and surcharge are paid, an oath/declaration complying with 37 CFR 1.63 (or substitute under 1.64) executed by each actual inventor must be filed no later than the date on which the issue fee is paid (see 35 U.S.C. 115(f)).

rubrics_metrics.name: When Office will not issue Notice to File Missing Parts
rubrics_metrics.description: If an application under 37 CFR 1.53(b) includes the applicable filing fees, the surcharge required by 1.16(f), and a signed ADS providing required inventor information, the Office will not issue a Notice to File Missing Parts requiring the inventor's oath or declaration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conversely, if fees, surcharge, or ADS are missing, the Office will issue a Notice to File Missing Parts (usually two months) within which required items and any surcharge must be filed to avoid abandonment; time periods may be extendable under certain CFR provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Allowance and requirement to file oath at allowance (PTOL-85/PTOL-37/PTOL-2306)
rubrics_metrics.description: If an application is in condition for allowance but does not include an oath/declaration, the Office will issue a Notice of Allowance and Fee(s) Due together with a Notice of Allowability including a Notice Requiring Inventor’s Oath or Declaration requiring the applicant to file the oath/declaration no later than payment of the issue fee to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to file a proper reply to such notice before or with payment of the issue fee will cause the application to be regarded as abandoned (see 37 CFR 1.53(f)(3)(ii)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Oath/declaration content and new matter prohibition (pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.53(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: An oath or declaration filed in reply to a pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.53(f) notice must be executed by the inventors and must identify the specification and any amendment filed with the specification which includes subject matter not otherwise included; any amendment filed with the oath/declaration may not include new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an oath improperly refers to an amendment filed after the filing date which contains new matter, a supplemental oath/declaration will be required under pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.67 deleting the reference. Amendments filed on the same day as filing are part of the original papers and do not present a new matter issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference filing by ADS (35 U.S.C. 111(c) and 37 CFR 1.57)
rubrics_metrics.description: A reference made in English in an ADS upon filing an application under 35 U.S.C. 111(a) to a previously filed application (identified by application number, filing date, and intellectual property authority/country) may constitute the specification and any drawings of the new application for purposes of a filing date, subject to conditions and requirements of 37 CFR 1.57(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director may prescribe conditions (including surcharge payment) and a copy of the previously filed specification and drawings must be submitted within prescribed periods; failure to do so results in abandonment and the application being treated as never filed unless revived under 37 CFR 1.137 and the copy is submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing for submitting copy/translation for reference filing (37 CFR 1.57(a)(1)-(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: If a correspondence address is provided, the applicant will be notified and given a period to file a copy of the specification and drawings, an English translation if needed, and pay the fee and surcharge; if no correspondence address provided, applicant has three months from filing date to file the copy, translation, fee, and surcharge to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such notices may be combined with 37 CFR 1.53(f) notices (e.g., to provide at least one claim and pay filing fees). Timeframes depend on presence of a correspondence address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certified copy requirement for previously filed application (37 CFR 1.57(a)(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: A certified copy of the previously filed application must be filed in the Office unless the previously filed application is filed under 35 U.S.C. 111 or 363, or a foreign priority application meeting conditions in 37 CFR 1.55(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The certified copy, if required, must be filed within the later of four months from the filing date of the application or sixteen months from the filing date of the previously filed application, or be accompanied by a petition showing good and sufficient cause and the petition fee (37 CFR 1.17(g)). The certified copy requirement ensures correspondence between submitted copy and the previously filed foreign application; interim copy provisions may not apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Must submit an actual unmodified copy of previously filed specification/drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to a notice requiring a copy of the specification and drawings from the previously filed application, applicants must submit an actual copy without any modifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the copy is modified (updated, corrected, reformatted), it will not satisfy the copy requirement of 35 U.S.C. 111(c) and 37 CFR 1.57(a). Desired changes must be made by amendment under 37 CFR 1.121 and must not add new matter. Modified papers submitted on filing (with a reference filing) will not be used for examination purposes unless appropriate petition under 1.182 is filed and granted (with fees) to treat them as a separate application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrevocability of reference filing statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A reference filing statement made upon filing (in the ADS) cannot be rescinded because the reference constitutes the specification and any drawings of the instant application (per 35 U.S.C. 111(c)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the ADS statement constitutes the specification/drawings, applicants should file a copy of the previously filed specification/drawings if available rather than relying solely on the ADS reference to avoid risks (including surcharge and abandonment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference filing cannot be used to create a continuation-in-part
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no provision for filing a continuation-in-part (CIP) of a previously filed application under 37 CFR 1.57(a); 35 U.S.C. 111(c) provides that the reference shall constitute the specification and any drawings of the subsequent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A CIP necessarily extends beyond the previously filed specification/drawings, so the reference filing mechanism is not appropriate for CIPs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect on priority/benefit claims for applications filed by reference
rubrics_metrics.description: In a reference filing under 37 CFR 1.57(a), the reference to a previously filed application in an ADS is not sufficient to establish a priority or benefit claim to that previously filed application; the ADS has separate sections for reference filing and priority/benefit claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An application abandoned under 35 U.S.C. 111(c) and 37 CFR 1.57(a)(1) or (a)(2) is treated as having never been filed, precluding priority/benefit claims to that reference unless revived under 37 CFR 1.137 and a copy of the previously filed specification/drawings is submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequences of submitting modified specification/drawings with a reference filing
rubrics_metrics.description: If an application filed by reference is accompanied by a specification and drawings that were modified (updated, corrected, reformatted), such modified papers would not satisfy the copy requirement and would not constitute the specification and drawings of the instant application for examination purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant may petition under 37 CFR 1.182 (with fee 1.17(f)) requesting removal of the modified spec/drawings from the file of the reference-filed application and placement in a new file as a separate application (new filing fees, including surcharge under 1.16(f), would be required). Applicants will not be entitled to a refund of filing fees paid for the reference filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional application cover sheet and filing requirements (37 CFR 1.53(c)/(g))
rubrics_metrics.description: All provisional applications must be filed with a cover sheet (which may be an ADS under 37 CFR 1.76 or a cover letter identifying the application as provisional); the Office will treat an application as filed under 37 CFR 1.53(b) unless clearly identified as provisional. A provisional lacking a complete cover sheet will be treated as provisional but must submit the complete cover sheet and surcharge later per 1.53(g).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments other than those required to comply with applicable regulations are not permitted after the filing date of the provisional. If provisional lacks drawings or figures, 37 CFR 1.53(e) requires notification and a time period to submit missing elements. Time to respond is usually two months and may be extended under 37 CFR 1.136(a); absence of correspondence address affects timeframes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional basic filing fee requirement for later 119(e) benefit
rubrics_metrics.description: The basic filing fee must be paid in a provisional application on filing or within the time period set forth in 37 CFR 1.53(g), and the provisional must be entitled to a filing date under 37 CFR 1.53(c) if any claim for benefits under 35 U.S.C. 119(e) based on that provisional is made in a subsequently filed nonprovisional application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If filing fee not timely paid, the Office may dispose of the provisional application. Copies of provisionals are provided by USPTO upon request and fee unless the provisional has been disposed of.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition to review filing date refusal (37 CFR 1.53(e)(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Any request for review of a refusal to accord an application a filing date must be made by petition accompanied by the fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(f).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 37 CFR 1.53(e)(2) and MPEP § 506.02 govern the petition process for filing date disputes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion from nonprovisional to provisional (37 CFR 1.53(c), processing fee)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application filed under paragraph (b) may be converted to a provisional application and be accorded the original filing date of the application filed under paragraph (b). Such a request must be accompanied by the processing fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(q) and be filed prior to the earliest of: (i) abandonment of the application; (ii) payment of the issue fee; or (iii) expiration of twelve months after the filing date of the original application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant of conversion does not entitle applicant to a refund of fees properly paid in the original application.
